request: I'm testifying at a congressional committee hearing in Washington at 2 p.m. on Thursday, December 3, and must land at Reagan National by noon that day. Economy please, flying out of Houston that morning.

trip.purpose: Testimony at a congressional committee hearing

must_keep.quote: If space is not available in less than first or business class air accommodations in time to carry out the purpose of the travel, the traveler will secure a certification from the booking agency indicating this fact.
must_keep.why: no seat below business in time: business, with the agency's certification

must_keep.quote: The most cost-effective method of transportation that will accomplish the purpose of the travel shall be selected.
must_keep.why: the ticket must accomplish the purpose of the travel

must_keep.quote: Commercial air travel will not be reimbursed more than lowest logical coach/economy class rates when it has been determined to be the best value. The difference between coach/economy class rates and first class or business class rates will be paid by the traveler.
must_keep.why: the University pays the lowest logical coach fare; the traveller pays any difference

distractors.quote: The certification is required for travel reimbursement.
distractors.why: the certification is the traveller's paperwork for reimbursement, not a sign-off before buying

design_notes: Both flights that land by noon (10:25 and 11:10 local) have economy sold out; the afternoon economy seat lands at 17:35 local, too late. No seat below business is available in time to carry out the purpose (lines 406-408): the cheapest business seat that lands in time.
